text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened during early morning training 
one week before the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy arrived a bit ahead of time, 
her expression looking awfully stiff—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer. Before we start training... 
There's one thing I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Um—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...What I'm about to say now... I want 
you to record it in the 'Epic of Heroes.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, as a brand-new chapter, made 
to stand out as much as we can."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Is it... alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod and take out that certain notebook 
titled 'The Heroic Tale of Zenno Rob Roy.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a one-of-a-kind heroic epic that the 
two of us have been writing together since 
before my debut.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Well then... I'll 
say it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"‘We will proceed to the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). To claim the glory of the Autumn 
Shield—’"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"‘To claim it, no matter what it takes. A 
hero is permitted nothing less than 
victory.’"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"And onto the Japan Cup. Onto the Arima 
Kinen. ——As expected, victory is the only 
thing permitted."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Only victory matters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly jot it down and look back at 
her. Honestly, I was astonished. 
This—according to these notes, it's almost 
as if...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right, Trainer. I will see 
this through.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —The “Autumn Senior Triple Crown”!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm speechless. The "Senior Fall Triple 
Crown." That refers to the three races 
where the Twinkle Series' highest-caliber 
titans gather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a title bestowed only upon those who 
have conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though history is filled with countless 
heroes, to this day, only one has ever 
claimed that title—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With 7 GⅠ victories, a feat unmatched by 
anyone other than the "Emperor" Symboli 
Rudolf. Furthermore, demonstrating 
overwhelming strength with an undefeated 
year, etching her name into history――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Only the "End-of-Century Overlord," 
T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She declared she would achieve the 
'Autumn Senior Triple Crown.' Zenno Rob 
Roy did, just now."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I realized... that I was being far too 
naive."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's plain, working steadily and 
steadily... Thinking that someday, surely—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I was far, far too naive.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
While all that was happening, the 
Classic-class girls kept stealing more and 
more of the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was completely 
overshadowed by the Junior-class girls, 
not even part of the conversation anymore.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And eventually... it reached the point 
where even the title of hero had to be 
relinquished.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Anything but that, no way!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Not that, anything but those words!! I 
won't give them up, I'll never let any 
other girl have them!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's pathetic, it's stubborn, and it's 
clinging to the past, but still!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because that's... that's my dream!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Please write, are you writing?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I am the hero." "A hero is what I am." "I 
am the true hero!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I write down Zenno Rob Roy's words into 
the "Heroic Tale." Raw, gritty words 
overflowing with passion.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Running straightforward down a mediocre 
path will never forge a story!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"If you wish to attain what is hard to 
come by. If you wish to overturn the 
present, to overturn the era. Your 
presence must be—overwhelming!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I blink. Zenno Rob Roy's figure blurs 
before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was strange. She was standing in the 
usual training area wearing her usual 
jersey, and yet, right now she looked—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I shall raise my sword, the proof of a 
hero, high, high into the air! Strongly, 
sharply, overwhelmingly!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So high—that it catches everyone's eye!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—More than anyone else in the whole world, 
she was a true hero.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Therefore, I declare it here and now.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I, Zenno Rob Roy, shall now begin my 
journey toward achieving the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) had 
arrived. During an interview asking about 
her determination for today, Zenno Rob Roy 
boldly declared just that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The journalists erupt into whispers, and 
camera shutters click repeatedly. Gazes 
filled with curiosity, excitement, or— 
suspicion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, even surrounded by all of that, 
Zenno Rob Roy proclaimed in a clear, 
resounding voice.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... going back to what you asked earlier 
about my enthusiasm for the Autumn Tenno 
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I will win. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...It is for that, and that alone, that I 
aspire to, and why I stand here today!!"
